name: Bay Gas Storage Extension
researcher_notes: Two independent sources agree on an 18 mile, 24 inch gas line completed in 2001 in Alabama. An Oil and Gas Journal article from December 2001 says Bay Gas Storage Company, a unit of EnergySouth in McIntosh, Alabama, finished the 18 mile, 24 inch Whistler gas pipeline. It carries 43 million cubic feet a day and connects the storage site to a Gulf South 30 inch line near Whistler, Alabama, to supply the Barry power plant. The Energy Information Administration pipeline projects release for August 2026 lists it on the Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 189, as Bay Gas Storage Extension, owner EnergySouth Gas Co, completed 22 July 2001, 18 miles, 24 inches, intrastate. The two sources are independent. Not a match to the tracker's Whistler Pipeline rows (P0319, P3682, P3683, P3887), which are a Texas system; the name overlap is coincidence. No tracker row covers it. Length of 18 miles is about 29 km, above the 25 km rule. Parent and owner spelling follow the source; no legal form was found for EnergySouth. No route was found; the sources give no map or geographic data. Intrastate line, so absence from FERC is expected. The EIA sheet also lists a separate 11 mile, 20 inch Bay Gas Storage Looping (FERC docket CP02-229, interstate); that is a different project and was not researched here.
